preview: Antigua & Barbuda Falcons face Saint Lucia Kings in CPL 2026 Match 3 at Arnos Vale Stadium. The match is scheduled for Sun 9 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The Falcons bring Antiguan fast bowler Alzarri Joseph home for 2026 and add Evin Lewis to a returning core that includes Fabian Allen, Jayden Seales and Amir Jangoo. Roston Chase and Matthew Forde anchor the returning group, joined by Jewel Andrew and a fresh Saint Lucian pathway that includes McKenny Clarke. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
